CREATE VIEW [DW].[FactCardsCreditLimit_PBIen_View]
	AS 

WITH FactCardsCreditLimit_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactCardsCreditLimit_PBIen as FDL
)

Select CCD.*
from DW.FactCardsCreditLimit_PBIen as CCD
    INNER JOIN FactCardsCreditLimit_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = CCD.BusinessDateSK
